types.description: C60N miniature circuit breaker / 2 poles / D curve / 16 A / bare breaker

document.title: Merlin Gerin — C60N kismegszakító, B, C, D karakterisztika
document.revision: Undated historical Hungarian catalog extract; no revision printed

modelingNotes: Exact 24587 row on B13 identifies C60N, 2P, D curve, 16 A; manufacturer-authored catalog at Ronsystemshop distributor mirror.

B13 diagram: marked terminals 1–2 and 3–4, two mechanically ganged protected poles. No fixed conducting links. Open contact state represents the illustrated OFF position, not a prediction of installed state.

B12: D curve calibrated at 40 °C; magnetic operation 10–14 In. For 2P, IEC/EN 60947-2 Icu is 20 kA at 230–240 V AC and 10 kA at 400–415 V AC; Ics is 75% Icu. These are conditional capabilities, not assigned circuit voltages.
B12 clamp capacities for ratings up to 25 A: 16 mm² flexible or 25 mm² rigid conductor. Connection policy shared does not specify permitted conductor count.
Candidate uses the historical row; manufacturer website inconsistency remains recorded. Swiss AC/DC title alone is not used to assign DC operating limits.

Bare breaker only; accessory terminals are outside this exact order. No neutral designation, PE, shield or communication connection in the applicable circuit diagram. Connections are application-dependent, so none universally required. No assigned nominal_voltage or AC-only terminal metadata.

connectionCoverage.notes: Four main screw terminals of the bare 2P breaker, marked 1, 2, 3, 4 in the exact catalog section. No accessory terminals included; no documented PE, neutral-specific, shield, signal or communication connections.
